behavior.name: 0x13004668
behavior.comment: The behavior parameter determines the part's index (from head to lowest body part).
behavior.description: A segment of a Pokey's body. These parts are managed by the main Pokey object and can be destroyed individually. They shift position and index when other parts are destroyed.

field.name: Part Index
field.description: Index of the body part, with 0 being the head.
